# RealCy.app

> Independent guide to everyday life in Cyprus: practical guides, local directories and planning tools for residents, organised into eight topics, plus city guides for Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca and Ayia Napa and new-build real estate listings. Also serves people planning a move to Cyprus.

Every guide, directory and tool belongs to one primary topic. Each topic has a hub page listing its guides, directories and tools (some items also appear on a second topic's hub). Hubs accept `?city=limassol|paphos|larnaca|ayia-napa` to show directories with entries in that city.

## Topics

- [Health](https://realcy.app/health/): GeSY, doctors, pharmacies, insurance and what to do in an emergency.
- [Getting around](https://realcy.app/getting-around/): Buses, driving, licences, car hire, airports and ferries across Cyprus.
- [Home & bills](https://realcy.app/home-and-bills/): Renting a home, utilities, internet, recycling, water and solar.
- [Money & paperwork](https://realcy.app/money-and-paperwork/): Banking, tax returns, social insurance, residence permits and running a business.
- [Food & shopping](https://realcy.app/food-and-shopping/): Markets, international groceries, food delivery and eating like a local.
- [Family & schools](https://realcy.app/family-and-schools/): Schools, nurseries, activities for children and family paperwork.
- [Community & leisure](https://realcy.app/community-and-leisure/): Meeting people, sport, culture, the outdoors and learning Greek.
- [Moving to Cyprus](https://realcy.app/moving-to-cyprus/): Visas, residency routes, tax status, buying property and planning the move.

## Health

Hub: https://realcy.app/health/

### Guides

- [GeSY Registration Guide 2026: Step-by-Step](https://realcy.app/guides/gesy-registration-guide/): Register for GeSY at gesyportal.hio.org.cy: step-by-step walkthrough for Cyprus expats: documents needed, GP selection, 2026 contribution rates, and what the public healthcare system covers.
- [Buy Medicine Over the Counter in Cyprus](https://realcy.app/guides/pharmacies-medication/): What you can buy over the counter in Cyprus: paracetamol, ibuprofen, some codeine painkillers. Plus GeSY €1 generics and foreign prescription rules.
- [Dental Care in Cyprus 2026: Costs & GeSY Cover](https://realcy.app/guides/dental-care-guide/): Private dental costs in Cyprus in 2026: fillings from €80, implants from €800, crowns from €400. What GeSY actually covers (almost nothing for adults), how prices compare to UK and German rates, and how to find an English-speaking dentist.
- [Emergency Services in Cyprus: 112 & A&E Guide](https://realcy.app/guides/emergency-services-guide/): The single emergency number, which hospitals have 24-hour A&E, ambulance response times, what to bring, and the difference between public and private A&E for non-critical situations.
- [Air Quality & Allergens in Cyprus: Expat Guide](https://realcy.app/guides/air-quality-allergens/): Saharan dust events, pollen seasons, wildfire smoke, where to find AQI data, and practical steps for relocators who suffer from hay fever or respiratory conditions.
- [Healthcare in Cyprus 2026: GeSY & Private Guide](https://realcy.app/guides/healthcare-in-cyprus/): How healthcare works in Cyprus in 2026: the national GeSY system, private hospitals, insurance, dental, mental health and emergencies.
- [Private Health Insurance in Cyprus 2026](https://realcy.app/guides/private-health-insurance-cyprus/): What GeSY doesn't cover, the five gaps private insurance fills, residency requirements for non-EU applicants, and how to compare plans as a Cyprus expat.

### Local directories

- [Specialist Doctors](https://realcy.app/sections/specialist-doctors/): English-speaking specialist consultants with GeSY status and private pricing.
- [Mental Health Services](https://realcy.app/sections/mental-health-services/): English-speaking therapists, psychologists, and psychiatrists across Cyprus.
- [Veterinary Services](https://realcy.app/sections/veterinary-services/): English-speaking vet clinics with emergency care and specialist referrals.

### Tools

- [Cyprus Health Insurance Comparison](https://realcy.app/tools/health-insurance-comparison/): Compare private health insurance plans in Cyprus by coverage, premium, deductible, and network. Understand what GeSY covers versus what requires top-up insurance.

Prices and rules change, verify with official Cyprus sources before acting.

- [Cyprus Ferry Routes 2026: Piraeus, Crete & Egypt](https://realcy.app/guides/ferry-routes-guide/): Limassol to Piraeus via Crete with Grimaldi Lines (36-40 hrs). Cyprus to Egypt and Haifa ferry status, car rates from €250 and how to book in 2026.
- [Driving in Cyprus: Road Safety & Culture Guide](https://realcy.app/guides/road-safety-driving/): Everything you need to know before driving in Cyprus: left-hand traffic, speed limits, camera locations, accident procedures, and an honest assessment of local driving culture.

- [Getting Around Cyprus Without a Car (2026)](https://realcy.app/guides/getting-around-cyprus-no-car/): Honest guide to Cyprus public transport for expats: intercity buses, city routes, Bolt, shared taxis, and which cities work without a car.

- [Buying vs Renting in Cyprus: 2026 Guide](https://realcy.app/guides/buying-vs-renting-cyprus/): Buy or rent in Cyprus? Our 2026 guide covers transaction costs, break-even timelines, rental yields, and city price data to help you decide.

- [Employee Rights in Cyprus (2026 Guide)](https://realcy.app/guides/working-in-cyprus-employee-rights/): Minimum wage, annual leave, notice periods, social insurance and the 13th salary: a plain-English guide to Cyprus employment law for expats.

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://realcy.app/tools/mortgage-calculator/): Calculate monthly payments, total interest, and an amortization schedule for a Cyprus property purchase. Covers standard LTV limits for residents and non-residents.

Get a full itemised breakdown with low/midpoint/high ranges and a 10% contingency buffer.
- [Cyprus Pet Import Checklist](https://realcy.app/tools/pet-import-checklist/): Generate a personalised checklist for importing your dog, cat, bird, or other pet into Cyprus. Covers microchipping, rabies titre tests, health certificates, and arrival procedures based on your pet type and country of origin.
